improvement: A reported-end-date follow-up can now replace the period with an explicit inclusive ISO date range while retaining the selected FONGIM, World Bank or EU project identifiers. English 'between/from' and French 'entre/du' forms are supported; fresh source records remain authoritative.
reproduced_before: Follow-ups such as 'Which of those projects have a reported end date between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31?' returned no structured resolution even though the date engine already supported the inclusive range.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only the selected source identifiers, active-only flag when previously established by a recognised table, and the newly requested date range are carried. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and other source-family identifiers are excluded.
qualification.range_guard: Malformed dates, reversed ranges, analytical additions and multiple or conflicting periods defer to semantic resolution.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: A mixed roster without an explicitly named source family remains ambiguous.
qualification.api_guard: The explicit-source range path skips semantic rewriting and invokes one fresh research lookup in the API test.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test English and French explicit ranges, mixed-roster source selection, generic ambiguity, active-only continuity, fresh citations, FONGIM selected ID 664, and Mali 815 to Gao 44.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue, mixed-source disambiguation or explicit-range fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 topic-change or broader supported-time-filter continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only recognised reported-end-date follow-up wording and unambiguous ISO date ranges use this deterministic path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
